newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki extends OTC, Brokers' list trading hours.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki extends OTC, Brokers' list trading hours.

text.p: The Helsinki Stock Exchange on Tuesday said it would extend after-hours trading on its OTC list and Brokers' list by 1-1/2 hours to end at 1730/1430 GMT from October 1.
Official trading hours for stocks on the lists would still end at 1500/1200 GMT, the exchange said in a statement, adding that the changes applied only to these lists and not the main board.
